notes: apr is a fraction and is 0.0 because the interest is 0% when paid on time. Late fees are not modeled. Neither page states a minimum or maximum order amount, and Afterpay says spending limits differ by shopper, so this file does not claim that any given refrigerator price qualifies. BnplTerms has no field for a limit; whoever shows the BNPL path should say the terms apply only when the shopper is approved for that amount.
